title: Early-Step Safety Steering: How Few Steps Really Recover Safety?

original_idea.body: Adaptive CoT jailbreaks vs a cheap CoT-length anomaly detector (extends arXiv:2605.24497): engineer simple surface features from CoT-jailbreak traces, fit logistic regression, report detection AUROC.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A cheap CoT-channel attack monitor is a concrete, deployable detection chain; negative result also informative.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Trace collection + simple features + logistic regression; accessible to a beginner.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped detection-AUROC deliverable with engineered features.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Forward-pass-only monitor on open reasoning models; independent-friendly.

novelty.reasoning: Cheap surface-feature detector vs adaptive CoT attacks likely untested.
